methodology.clock: Native tick at 0.1 game seconds; each case uses a new isolated browser context.
methodology.profiles: Legal creation points, level allocations and rebirth carry from createProfile; native recomputeStats and buildAlly.
methodology.combat: Unmodified native attacks, skills, enemy spawns, transformations and reflection. Boss encounter selection is fixed; stats are not changed.
methodology.reflectionPressure: Four additional cases hold only the player ordinary attack schedule and offensive auto-cast until a native reflection window of the matching damage type appears. Enemy actions, environmental damage, defensive counters and healing remain active. No reflection status is inserted. For the two GM pressure cases, a normal final-stage weapon100 outfit waits first, then native equipItem equips the GM item during the natural window without replenishing HP.
methodology.supplies: 100 white potions; native auto-buy to 100; potion threshold 75%; native haste/class/blue potions enabled. No manually selected polymorph, cards, dolls or manually granted invulnerability; native equipment-forced transformations remain active.
methodology.skills: All class/level-legal skills learned; one legal mastery before rebirth, native all-masteries after rebirth. Mage auto-casts tornado; legal healing selected at 70% HP. Listed safe buffs use native automatic casts.
methodology.party: One knight leader plus 3 knights, 4 elves, 4 mages and 4 illusionists, all level150 reborn; 15 allies instantiated by native buildAlly from isolated test saves.
methodology.measurement: Read/write-transparent HP observers record bounded HP loss, native recovery, raw single-hit loss and minimum HP. Net DPS=(actual HP loss-native enemy recovery)/elapsed game time. Overkill is excluded from applied damage.
methodology.limitation: One fixed seed per configuration is a reproducible scenario, not a statistical estimate of win probability. Lair tests begin in the final room, retaining all seven native stages and mechanics.
